question: Feature Engineering quan trọng vì sao trong ML?
options: Garbage In Garbage Out: chất lượng features quyết định ~80% model performance cho tabular data. Feature tốt có thể biến linear model thắng deep learning
Chỉ quan trọng cho deep learning
explanation: 'Applied ML is basically feature engineering' (Andrew Ng). Domain knowledge → create meaningful features. VD: age+income → debt-to-income ratio much more predictive for loan default.

question: Target Encoding cho categorical features hoạt động thế nào?
options: Thay category bằng mean target value của category đó. VD: city='HN' → mean(price|city='HN') = 500M. Cẩn thận target leakage → dùng cross-validation encoding
explanation: High cardinality (10000 cities): one-hot tạo 10000 cột (sparse, overfit). Target encoding: 1 cột, smooth encoding. Risk: leakage → dùng leave-one-out hoặc k-fold encoding. CatBoost built-in ordered target encoding.

question: Feature Selection methods gồm những loại nào?
options: Filter (correlation, mutual information — nhanh), Wrapper (forward/backward selection, RFE — chính xác nhưng tốn compute), Embedded (L1 regularization, tree feature importance — build vào model)
explanation: Filter: independent of model, fast. Wrapper: test subsets with model, expensive but accurate. Embedded: L1/Lasso zeros out unimportant features during training. Practical: start with correlation + tree importance, refine with RFE.

question: Polynomial Features là gì?
options: Tạo features mới bằng cách tính tích và luỹ thừa features gốc — VD: từ [x1, x2] tạo [x1, x2, x1², x1·x2, x2²]. Capture nonlinear relationships cho linear models
explanation: sklearn.PolynomialFeatures(degree=2). Linear model + polynomial features ≈ polynomial regression. Nhưng cẩn thận: degree cao → quá nhiều features → overfitting. Interaction features (x1·x2) thường useful nhất.

question: AutoML tools (Auto-sklearn, H2O, TPOT) tự động hoá những gì?
options: End-to-end: preprocessing, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, ensemble — tìm best pipeline tự động. Rất tốt cho baseline, nhưng domain expert vẫn cần cho feature engineering
Thay thế hoàn toàn data scientist
explanation: Auto-sklearn: meta-learning + Bayesian optimization. H2O AutoML: run many models, stack best ones. TPOT: genetic programming for pipeline. Google AutoML: includes Neural Architecture Search. Good baseline, not magic.

question: Binning/Discretization continuous features làm gì?
options: Chia continuous variable thành bins (nhóm). VD: age → [0-18: trẻ, 18-65: trưởng thành, 65+: già]. Giảm noise, capture nonlinear effects cho linear models, nhưng mất information
explanation: Equal-width: [0-33, 33-66, 66-100]. Equal-frequency (quantile): mỗi bin cùng số data points. Custom (domain): clinical thresholds. Trade-off: lose granularity, gain robustness. Decision trees tự bin naturally.

question: Feature Importance từ tree-based models nên diễn giải thế nào?
options: Cẩn thận: correlated features chia sẻ importance (mỗi feature importance thấp nhưng cả nhóm quan trọng). High cardinality features bị biased high. Dùng Permutation Importance hoặc SHAP để cross-validate
Chỉ ranking không có ý nghĩa
explanation: Default: split-based importance (how often used to split). Permutation importance: shuffle 1 feature → measure accuracy drop → more reliable. SHAP: consistent, unified feature contributions per prediction.

question: Log transformation dùng khi nào?
options: Khi feature có right-skewed distribution (most values small, few very large — VD: income, house prices). Log biến thành gần normal distribution, giảm ảnh hưởng outliers
explanation: Income: [20K, 25K, 30K, 50K, 1M] → very skewed. log(income): [9.9, 10.1, 10.3, 10.8, 13.8] → more symmetric. Khi dùng algorithms giả định normality (linear regression). Cẩn thận: log(0) undefined → dùng log(1+x).

question: Multicollinearity ảnh hưởng gì và cách phát hiện?
options: Features highly correlated → model coefficient unstable, hard to interpret individual feature effects. Detect: correlation matrix (>0.9), VIF (Variance Inflation Factor) >5-10 → drop or combine features
explanation: height_cm và height_inch: gần perfect collinearity. Linear regression coefficients flip signs randomly. VIF = 1/(1-R²_feature). VIF>10: severe. Solutions: drop one, PCA, ridge regression (L2 handles multicollinearity).

question: Bayesian Optimization cho hyperparameter tuning ưu điểm gì so với Grid/Random Search?
options: Thông minh hơn: build probabilistic model (Gaussian Process) của objective function → choose next hyperparameter combo based on expected improvement → cần ít evaluations hơn
explanation: Grid: exhaustive, exponential cost. Random: surprisingly effective, embarrassingly parallel. Bayesian (Optuna, Hyperopt): learn from past evaluations → propose promising next config. 10-50x fewer evaluations than grid for similar quality.

question: Date/time features thường extract những gì?
options: Hour, day_of_week, month, quarter, is_weekend, is_holiday, days_since_event, cyclical encoding (sin/cos cho hour/month) — capture temporal patterns cho model
explanation: datetime → [hour=14, day_of_week=2(Wed), month=3, is_weekend=0, quarter=1]. Cyclical: sin(2π·hour/24), cos(2π·hour/24) → hour 23 gần hour 0. Rolling stats: mean_sales_last_7_days.

question: RFE (Recursive Feature Elimination) hoạt động thế nào?
options: Train model → rank features by importance → remove least important feature → retrain → repeat until desired number of features. Wrapper method: expensive nhưng accurate
explanation: sklearn.RFE(estimator=RandomForest(), n_features_to_select=10). Iteration: 100 features → remove worst → 99 → remove worst → ... → 10 best. RFECV: use cross-validation to find optimal number automatically.

question: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) là gì?
options: Tự động tìm kiến trúc neural network tối ưu (số layers, layer types, connections) cho task cụ thể. Rất tốn compute nhưng tìm ra architectures competitive với human-designed
explanation: EfficientNet: NAS-found architecture outperformed ResNet. NASNet: search on small dataset → transfer to ImageNet. DARTS: differentiable NAS, cheaper. AutoML Vision (Google): NAS for custom image classification. Cost: thousands of GPU hours.
